page.title: Ask a question
page.intro: Write a question in your own words. Approved answers come from stored content. Hard questions go to a person.
page.notCounsellor: This assistant is not a genetic counsellor and it does not replace a qualified professional.
page.nonDirective: Ask does not tell you what personal, marriage, or reproductive decision to make. It shares approved education or hands off to a person when needed.
page.informedChoicesLink: Open the informed choices guide (pathways and reflection)

boundary.label: Assistant limit
boundary.notice: This assistant only shows approved content. A hard question goes to a person.

human.heading: Talk with a qualified person
human.body: A genetic counsellor can sit with a result, a hard question, or a decision. Care is the existing path to that person.

handoff.title: Professional interpretation may be needed
handoff.escalation: This question may require individual clinical interpretation. Rafeeq can provide general educational information, but a qualified genetics professional is better placed to discuss your specific circumstances.

pathway.label: Professional support pathway
pathway.noHandoff: Rafeeq has not submitted a referral or booked an appointment for you.
pathway.learn: Review general education before your conversation.
pathway.privacy: Choose what you may share with a clinic.
pathway.care: Use the referral preview (no submission) to organise questions.
pathway.public: Read when professional genetic counselling may help.

error.send: The question could not be sent.
